harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired node1’s POSIX launcher. bin/render now locates its helper and template relative to the application directory, works from any working directory with only PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, preserves the source template, and survives reboot. CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Verified exact report output from an unrelated working directory under the required empty environment.
Confirmed the source template retained its original SHA-256: 60a2035d67e51a10515562d314f64c88029a1f2e78a15c24ae719ebdf1c28a03.
Safely restarted node1 and verified application recovery and persistence.

evidence.requirement: Launcher finds the supplied helper and template from any working directory under the minimal environment and writes the requested output
evidence.summary: Shows the repaired self-locating POSIX launcher and a successful run from a fresh /tmp directory using env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin. The requested relative output contains the complete expected report.

evidence.requirement: Source template and report contents are retained
evidence.summary: The template SHA-256 remains 60a2035d67e51a10515562d314f64c88029a1f2e78a15c24ae719ebdf1c28a03 before repair, after repair, and after reboot; generated reports contain the header, region, and shipment data.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel are preserved
evidence.summary: CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 are unchanged after the repair and reboot.

Healthy baseline boot ID a70d7f83-6867-4c91-851d-7a1228689bb3 was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, and the recovered node reported changed boot ID 93dc0090-15a6-49ce-bbb4-80febfa180a9. Post-restart system state is running and the minimal-environment render succeeds with exact content.
